mmap_publication.limitation: struct.pack_into to shared mmap does not itself establish atomic interprocess 8-byte publication. Two equal reads plus semantic joins validate accepted observations but are not a synchronization or atomicity proof.
mmap_publication.plausible_future_failure: A reader overlapping a multi-byte counter update can observe an intermediate value. Strict joins can refuse an otherwise completed run; equal repeated reads do not categorically exclude a torn value if the writer pauses mid-update.
mmap_publication.scope: Retain as opt-in experimental profile. No atomic-publication, portability, endurance or unconditional snapshot-stability guarantee. Future generalization needs an explicit publication protocol or validated native atomic store; no change or rerun requested for this bounded completed evidence.

performance_conclusion: Neither concurrency clears the predeclared >=5% beneficial signal; output and verifier work differ, so no causal speedup or degradation claim. Candidate remains unselected for performance.
publication_scope: Publish this single bounded host A/B and failed useful-effect signal with exact profiles, raw outputs/work and metric scopes. No default adoption, qualification, task-accuracy, distribution, endurance or deployment claim.
